system_summary: Universal capabilities, tools, MCPs, hooks, and memory anchors for tare.tools agents.

local_chat_model.model: any chat model behind a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint
local_chat_model.purpose: Local private chat and code reasoning

local_embed_model.model: any embedding model behind a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint
local_embed_model.purpose: Dense vector embeddings for the Library index; one vector namespace per model family

tools.name: mesh
tools.description: Tailscale mesh management: GPU telemetry, repo sync, remote exec in WSL2, daemon management, and diagnostics.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Fast knowledge retrieval, semantic dense vector search with latency-aware routing (ADR-055), and ADR/SPEC lookups.

tools.name: ingest
tools.description: Streaming document intake with automated SHA-256 hashing and deduplication.

tools.name: indexer
tools.description: Derived, rebuildable vector index (ADR-070): content-addressed incremental embedding with SHA-256 cache (ADR-058) over the Library corpus and owner checkouts read where they live, with GPU offload (ADR-053).

tools.name: bookkeeper
tools.description: Repository hygiene auditor, SSOT verifier, and artifact integrity checker.

tools.name: discovery
tools.description: Universal capability discovery, task context resolver, and MCP configuration generator.

tools.name: round_table
tools.description: Multi-Chair Architectural Round Table Consensus Engine (Google, Anthropic, OpenAI Chairs); lives in tare.tools.os and runs from its checkout.

hooks.name: compute_guard
hooks.description: Blocks heavy batches on thin clients and dispatches to the configured compute substrate (ADR-053).

hooks.name: adr_provenance_guard
hooks.description: Enforces the Triple Cryptographic Verification: hash(DECISION.md) == ADR.sha256 == journal[FINAL].decision_sha256 (ADR-057).
